The '''ANc 2.7 tracking computer''' was a [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computer]] manufactured by [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]]. It was the main [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computer]] on [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr Manufacturing]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]]. The [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter's]] targeting package paired the ANc 2.7 with a [[SI 5g7 "Quickscan" vector imaging system/Legends|SI 5g7 "Quickscan" imaging system]].<ref name="EGVV" />
